 ▲ candle   SETUP   nothing trades until your agent and its limits exist        
 ✓ 0  ▸ 1 Sign in to Candle  · 2  · 3  · 4  · 5                                 
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── step 1 of 5 ─╮
│                                                                              │
│  Sign in to Candle                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  This machine has no keychain, so the Candle CLI locks its sign-in file      │
│  with a passphrase you choose. Add this line to ~/.bashrc in an editor,      │
│  with a passphrase of your own, kept from then on:                           │
│                                                                              │
│    export CANDLE_KEYRING_PASSPHRASE="<a passphrase of your own>"             │
│  ▸ ⧉ Copy the line   paste it into ~/.bashrc in an editor, not at a prompt   │
│    ⧉ chmod 600 ~/.bashrc       run it after, so only you can read the file   │
│                                                                              │
│  Then quit (ctrl-c twice) and run candle-harness in a new terminal.          │
│                                                                              │
│  Or keep the owner sign-in off this machine: make an agent's key where       │
│  you're signed in, quit, and add it here:                                    │
│    ⧉ candle-harness key add --agent agent-a            it asks for the key   │
│                                                                              │
│  This isn't a vault's passphrase. It only locks the CLI's sign-in file.      │
│                                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 ↑/↓ moves · ⏎ or a click picks · esc back                      ctrl-c ×2 quits
